en.headline: Police investigate suspected drink spiking after Japanese DJ hospitalised in Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: Former adult film actress Mao Hamasaki, now working as a DJ, is in intensive care after tests showed positive reactions to four types of drugs, police said.
body: Police are investigating a suspected case of administering poison with intent to injure after a woman was taken to hospital from a venue in Tsim Sha Tsui in the early hours of Sunday.

The woman, identified in reports as Mao Hamasaki, a former Japanese adult film actress who has been working as a disc jockey in Hong Kong, was admitted to intensive care. Her manager said hospital tests showed positive reactions to four types of drugs, including substances commonly referred to as Happy water and others.

According to the manager, Hamasaki had been performing as a DJ in Wan Chai before going to a private venue on Mody Road in Tsim Sha Tsui. She was said to have consumed a drink that later appeared to contain a white powder-like substance at the bottom. She collapsed after finishing a performance and experienced convulsions, the manager said.

Police said they received a report at about 4:57am from a male colleague that a female colleague had become unwell after drinking at a venue at 65 Mody Road. Officers from the Yau Tsim District Crime Unit are handling the case. No arrests have been made.

Hamasaki’s social media account posted that she had been drugged while working, accompanied by photographs of her being attended by police and taken to hospital. The manager said she had regained consciousness by Sunday morning but remained in intensive care.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀私竇打碟疑遭落藥 日籍DJ送ICU 警列施用毒藥調查
zh.dek: 前日本AV女優濱崎真緒現以DJ身分在港工作，院方驗出體內對四種藥物呈陽性反應，警方正跟進。
body: 警方正調查一宗意圖損害等而施用毒藥案件，一名女子周日凌晨在尖沙咀一場所被送院。
該女子據報為濱崎真緒，前日本成人電影演員，近年在港以DJ Mao身分活動。她的經理人表示，醫院化驗顯示她對四種藥物呈陽性反應，包括俗稱Happy水等物質，目前在深切治療部留醫。
經理人稱，濱崎真緒在灣仔完成打碟工作後，前往尖沙咀麼地道一處私人場所。期間她飲下一杯後來發現杯底有白色粉末狀沉澱物的飲品，完成表演後不支倒地並出現抽筋。
警方表示，凌晨約4時57分接獲一名男同事報案，指女同事在麼地道65號一場所飲用飲品後不適。案件交由油尖警區刑事調查隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。
濱崎真緒的社交平台帖文稱「工作中給人下藥了」，並附上警員到場及她被送院的照片。經理人表示她周日早上已恢復清醒，但仍在深切治療部留醫。
